R01: R01 closed on F-01.1 (pilot sets AP targets); Be-01.1 direct entry primary, Be-01.2 step and Be-01.3 preset as complements; Structure = WAD Setpoint Panel with keypad/steppers/presets (Touch) and bezel rotary + UCP (Keyboard), both paths modality-complete.
R02: R02 closed on F-02.1 (pilot aware AP reached target); Be-02.1 discrete event announcement (Screen convergence + one-shot audio callout), modality-complete. Structure = shared AP Target/Current panel (WAD) + audio callout (Audio system, shared notify channel) + dedicated 'reached' flag (HUD).
R03: R03 closed on F-03.1 (engage an autopilot mode); Be-03.1.1 direct one-shot mode selection, modality-complete. Structure = Autopilot Mode Panel (WAD, Touch, shared with R02) + Bezel mode OSS (Keyboard).
R04: R04 closed on F-04.1 (terminate active AP mode) and F-04.2 (enable manual selection), kept as two Functions once given distinct Behaviours. Be-04.1 re-press-to-deselect (→F-04.1); Be-04.2 one-shot MANUAL affordance (→F-04.2); both modality-complete. Structure reused/extended from R03: WAD mode panel (re-tap) + bezel OSS (shared) + dedicated MANUAL touch button (WAD).
R05: R05 closed on F-05.1 (submit structured intel reports to C2). Be-05.1: press-and-hold on Map → option ring → select preset marker → commit/send, modality-complete (Touch/Keyboard). Structure: Map view + option ring + preset buttons + marker glyph layer, all reused/shared with R06/R07 (map-anchored task pattern). Touchpad hardware proposal rejected (not in baseline). Spin-off logged: voice-annotated reporting (separate Function, not designed).
R06: R06 closed on F-06.1 (convey order content to pilot). Be-06.1.1: full parallel presentation — persistent Screen order panel + full templated TTS on arrival. Structure: WAD Order Content Panel + TTS readout (shared R02 channel) + supplementary HUD flag.
R07: Pilot transmits classified surveillance event reports to C2 via a map-anchored classify-then-commit UI (touch or keyboard), reusing R05/R06 widgets with only surveillance-specific event taxonomy added.
R08: R08 delivers pilot notifications (confirmations, messages, state-changes) via redundant audio-plus-visual alerts, using shared audio tones plus reusable multi-mode pop-up, notification-marker, and messages-tab components (extending R02 and R06).
R09: R09 lets a pilot dispatch a control-transfer request to a selected UAV via one unified takeover control surfaced across three shared invocation surfaces (dedicated button, option ring, and detail panel).
R10: A confirmation-gated one-shot takeover commit, offered via three ack-enabled surfaces (dedicated button, option-ring segment, or UAV detail-panel row).
R11: R11 lets pilots submit/adjust UAV speed, altitude, and heading via a re-instantiated Setpoint-Panel (multi-modal direct entry, steppers, and presets) with acknowledgment reusing the shared R08 notification stack.
R12: Toggles UAV status panel visibility using a reused Detail/Status Panel with a persistent toggle control plus a header close (X).
R13: UAV status monitoring with severity-graded alerts, implemented via a persistent extended R12 status panel plus an always-on HUD strip that escalates top-severity, R08-driven audio-visual alerts.
R14: R14 lets pilots aim the UAV's ISR sensor at a target via multi-modal (touch/HMD, discrete/continuous) designation surfaces reusing the shared press-hold option-ring pattern.
R15: Search-pattern input combining a map-anchored geometry editor (draggable handles + bound coordinate fields) for area shaping and a reused Setpoint Panel for scan attributes.
R16: R16 provides on-demand ISR feed access and source selection via a toggleable ISR Feed Panel (reusing the R12/R13 chassis) with multi-source tab/rotary controls across touch and keyboard.
R17: R17 lets the pilot designate a target and command the UAV to track it, reusing R14/R16's Map/ISR designation surface and adding only a TRACK commit affordance (option-ring segment + bezel OSS + detail row).
R18: Sets the UAV's numeric standoff distance from the target via a reused Setpoint Panel (touch/keyboard redundant entry) plus an inline quick-edit row in the tracking panel.
R19: R19 initiates UAV control handover to the UAV Pilot via touch/keyboard/mixed inputs, reusing existing button, option-ring, and detail-panel structures (from R09/R10/R17) with only a HANDOVER action binding added.
R20: Confirmation-gated one-shot UAV handover commit, executed via an armed-after-ack HANDOVER-EXECUTE binding reused across the three shared touch surfaces plus keyboard.
